audio_info: get the sample rate, duration, and channel count of an audio file
audio_read: read an audio file into a PyTorch tensor with optional seek and duration parameters
audio_write: write a PyTorch audio tensor to disk as wav, mp3, ogg, or flac with normalization
get_spec: compute a mel-spectrogram from raw audio data using librosa
save_spectrograms: plot and save mel-spectrograms for multiple audio clips as an image file
